# a5view

a5view visualises [A5](https://a5geo.org) cells in R.
[a5R](https://github.com/belian-earth/a5R) creates, indexes and
transforms cells; a5view draws them, as static plots through ggplot2 or
as interactive maps in the browser. Both take a vector of `a5_cell`s or
a data frame with a cell column and draw the cells directly, with no
conversion to polygons first.

| Task | Functions |
|----|----|
| Static plots | [`geom_a5()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/geom_a5.md): a ggplot2 layer that works with scales, [`geom_sf()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/ggsf.html) layers and any [`coord_sf()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/ggsf.html) projection |
| Interactive maps | [`a5_view()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_view.md): an htmlwidget built on [deck.gl](https://deck.gl) and [MapLibre](https://maplibre.org), for the viewer, R Markdown, Quarto and Shiny |
| Colour composites | [`cells_rgb()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/cells_rgb.md), [`cells_pca_rgb()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/cells_pca_rgb.md): map several bands or an embedding to RGB, in either of the above |
| Large datasets | [`a5_build_pyramid()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_build_pyramid.md), [`a5_view_pyramid()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_view_pyramid.md): level-of-detail pyramids streamed to the browser |

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("belian-earth/a5view")
```

a5view 0.3.0 draws [A5
1.0](https://github.com/felixpalmer/a5/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) cell ids,
as produced by a5R \>= 0.9.9.9000. Ids written by earlier versions of
a5R are valid 1.0 cells in the wrong place, so a5view cannot tell them
apart and draws them where 1.0 puts them; convert them once with
[`a5R::a5_migrate()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5R/reference/a5_migrate.html).
Use a5view 0.2.x for pre-1.0 ids.

## Example data

The examples below use `s2_santiago`, which ships with the package:
15,626 resolution-18 cells (about 22 m across) of a [cloud-free
Sentinel-2
mosaic](https://source.coop/earthgenome/sentinel2-temporal-mosaics) over
Parque O’Higgins in Santiago, Chile, with the blue, green, red and
near-infrared bands.

``` r

library(a5view)

head(s2_santiago)
#>               cell  B02  B03  B04  B08
#> 1 32b5c12040800000 1919 2165 2432 2445
#> 2 32b5c12041800000 1259 1575 1831 2254
#> 3 32b5c12042800000 2047 2414 2597 2807
#> 4 32b5c12043800000  989 1228 1441 2077
#> 5 32b5c12044800000 1305 1527 1663 2179
#> 6 32b5c12045800000 1121 1355 1569 2023
```

Sentinel-2 mosaic by Earth Genome (CC-BY 4.0). Contains modified
Copernicus Sentinel data 2023.

## Static plots with ggplot2

[`geom_a5()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/geom_a5.md)
takes the cells through the `cell` aesthetic.
[`cells_rgb()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/cells_rgb.md)
maps the red, green and blue bands to a true-colour composite; its
output is already colour, so no scale is needed.

``` r

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(s2_santiago, aes(cell = cell, fill = cells_rgb(B04, B03, B02, range = c(300, 2800)))) +
  geom_a5() +
  labs(title = "Sentinel-2 true colour, Santiago 2023")
```

![](reference/figures/README-ggplot-rgb-1.png)

Any fill scale works. Like
[`geom_sf()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/ggsf.html),
[`geom_a5()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/geom_a5.md)
plots in longitude and latitude by default, and
[`coord_sf()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/ggsf.html)
reprojects the cells, here NDVI (a vegetation index) in UTM zone 19S:

``` r

ggplot(s2_santiago, aes(cell = cell, fill = (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04))) +
  geom_a5() +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Greens", direction = 1, name = "NDVI") +
  coord_sf(crs = 32719) +
  theme_minimal()
```

![](reference/figures/README-ggplot-utm-1.png)

Cells are drawn as polygons while they are large on the page and as a
raster at the output resolution once they are smaller than a few pixels,
so a plot of millions of cells costs about the same as one of thousands.
`render = "vector"` or `"raster"` fixes the choice.

## Interactive maps

[`a5_view()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_view.md)
draws the same data on a web map. deck.gl and
[a5-js](https://github.com/felixpalmer/a5) render the cells on the GPU
from their ids, so the boundaries are never computed in R. `fill`
accepts a column, an expression of columns or a colour helper, as
[`aes()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/aes.html) does.

``` r

s2_santiago$NDVI <- with(s2_santiago, (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04))

a5_view(s2_santiago, fill = NDVI, opacity = 0.8, tooltip = c("B04", "B08"))
```

![](reference/figures/README-interactive-1.png)

The map has:

- colour mapping through any
  [`hcl.colors()`](https://rdrr.io/r/grDevices/palettes.html) palette,
  with an on-map legend;
- basemaps from [OpenFreeMap](https://openfreemap.org) (dark, light and
  OSM, with no API key) and Esri satellite imagery, with labels drawn
  above the cells;
- a hover tooltip showing the cell id, fill value and any extra columns,
  and click to pin a cell;
- an opacity slider, zoom and compass control, and scale bar;
- cell borders, 3D extrusion (`elevation`) and a globe projection
  (`globe = TRUE`).

## Large datasets

By default a widget sends every cell to the browser, which suits small
and medium datasets. For larger ones, `aggregate` builds a
level-of-detail pyramid: coarser cells summarise their children
(`"mean"` for scalar fields, `"rep_child"` to keep one representative
child for colour composites), and the browser decodes only the levels
and areas in view.
[`a5_build_pyramid()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_build_pyramid.md)
writes the pyramid to a parquet file once, so it can be viewed again
without rebuilding.

``` r

a5_view(cells, fill = value, aggregate = "mean")

a5_build_pyramid(cells, "cells.parquet", fill = value, aggregate = "mean")
a5_view_pyramid("cells.parquet")
```

Inside Shiny the parquet file is served with HTTP range requests, so
only the row groups in view are transferred.

## Shiny

[`a5_viewOutput()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_viewOutput.md)
and
[`renderA5_view()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/renderA5_view.md)
place a map in an app, and
[`a5_view_update()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_view_update.md)
changes its cells and colours in place without resetting the view. The
hovered and clicked cells arrive as `input$<id>_hover` and
`input$<id>_click`.

Setting `draw_polygon = TRUE` adds a polygon tool to the toolbar. Clicks
place vertices, a double-click closes the polygon, and the polygon
arrives as WKT at `input$<id>_polygon_draw`. The widget does not
highlight the cells inside it: resolve the WKT to cells on the server
and send new fills with
[`a5_view_update()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_view_update.md).

``` r

a5_viewOutput("map")

# server
output$map <- renderA5_view({
  a5_view(my_cells, draw_polygon = TRUE)
})

observeEvent(input$map_polygon_draw, {
  cells_in_poly <- a5R::a5_polygon_to_cells(
    wk::wkt(input$map_polygon_draw),
    resolution = 4L
  ) |>
    a5R::a5_uncompact()
  # ... use cells_in_poly, e.g. a5_view_update() with selection-driven fills.
})
```

See `inst/examples/polygon-select/app.R` for a complete app combining
click and polygon selection.

# Package index

## Static plots

Draw cells in ggplot2, alongside
[`geom_sf()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/ggsf.html) layers
and in any projection.

- [`geom_a5()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/geom_a5.md)
  : A5 cells as a ggplot2 layer

## Interactive maps

Draw cells on a web map with deck.gl and MapLibre.

- [`a5_view()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_view.md)
  : View A5 cells on an interactive map

## Colour composites

Map several bands or an embedding to per-cell RGB colours.

- [`cells_rgb()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/cells_rgb.md)
  : Build per-cell packed-integer RGB colours from three numeric
  channels
- [`cells_pca_rgb()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/cells_pca_rgb.md)
  : Build per-cell RGB colours from the first three principal components
  of an embedding

## Large datasets

Build level-of-detail pyramids and view them without rebuilding.

- [`a5_build_pyramid()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_build_pyramid.md)
  : Build and save an A5 pyramid parquet file
- [`a5_view_pyramid()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_view_pyramid.md)
  : View a prebuilt A5 pyramid parquet file

## Shiny

Place maps in apps and update them in place.

- [`a5_viewOutput()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_viewOutput.md)
  : Shiny output binding for a5_view
- [`renderA5_view()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/renderA5_view.md)
  : Shiny render function for a5_view
- [`a5_view_update()`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/a5_view_update.md)
  : Update a5_view layer data without full re-render

## Data

Example data.

- [`s2_santiago`](https://belian-earth.github.io/a5view/reference/s2_santiago.md)
  : Sentinel-2 cells over central Santiago, Chile
